mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.project_id, p.name AS project_name, d.name, d.category, d.current_version, d.status, d.file_size, d.file_format, d.uploader_name, DATE_FORMAT(d.upload_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS upload_date, d.description, su.name AS reviewer_name, DATE_FORMAT(d.review_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS review_time, d.review_remark FROM biz_document d LEFT JOIN biz_project p ON d.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON d.reviewer_id = su.id WHERE d.id = #{id}
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM biz_document WHERE category IS NOT NULL AND category != '' GROUP BY category
